authority_note: This bundle prepares PAPER strategy activation only. It does not modify or authorize the active Stage-E candidate or any market workload.

only_unresolved_inputs: final Stage-E SHA/tree and regenerated hashes/identities mechanically derived from the final composed bytes

required_baseline_preflight: exact final Stage-E source contains the intended six-regime Pump/Pons architecture
moderate-admission threshold revision is the intended active baseline
Pump and Pons shared-sleeve reservation authority is present
Meteora and Ramses active baseline identities match the final Stage-E receipt

activation_items.label: Directional capital parity
activation_items.frozen_behavior: Pump Current, Pump Survivor, Pons Current and Pons Survivor each request 500 bps (5%) of their family sleeve before mandatory downsizing.
acceptance_proofs: all four directional regimes request exactly 500 bps before caps
shared Pump/Pons sleeves remain single sleeves with no new capital lane
turnover/depth/stress/breadth/available-capital checks can only downsize

activation_items.label: Realized-equity compounding
activation_items.frozen_behavior: The common 5% target compounds from immutable family-sleeve genesis capital plus durable reconciled realized P&L; unrealized P&L has zero sizing authority.
activation_items.supersession: This layer is the authoritative sizing basis. Item 1 freezes the 500-bps target; item 2 replaces any fixed-genesis target calculation with realized-equity sizing.
acceptance_proofs: 125 realized-equity units -> 6.25-unit target equivalent
durable profit increases and durable loss decreases the next target
unrealized marks and partial nonterminal P&L cannot increase target
restart/replay reconstructs identical realized equity and target

activation_items.label: Pump Current exits
activation_items.frozen_behavior: Pump Current uses -8% hard stop, +15% first realization selling 25%, two-confirmation demand deterioration and a 14% proportional high-water price trail below the common tail arm.
activation_items.supersession: The exit-optimization 1400-bps value is interpreted as a proportional high-water price drawdown after right-tail composition, not a fixed return-point subtraction. Item 6 supersedes trail behavior at/above +100% high-water.
acceptance_proofs: hard stop exactly -800 bps
first realization exactly +1500 bps and 25% original quantity
below +100% high-water the trail uses proportional price drawdown
fixed return-point trail is absent from final composed Pump Current

activation_items.label: Pons Current exits
activation_items.frozen_behavior: Pons Current uses -8% hard stop, +18% first realization selling 25%, 12% normal proportional high-water trail, adverse flow only at sells >=1.20x buys, and two-confirmation soft deterioration.
activation_items.supersession: Item 6 supersedes normal trail behavior at/above +100% high-water. The 1.20x adverse-flow and deterioration exits remain independent safety/management exits.
acceptance_proofs: first realization is 25%, not legacy 33.33%
11% sell/buy excess does not trigger the immediate adverse-flow exit; 20% does at the exact boundary
both pre-graduation and post-graduation Current runner paths receive the tail overlay

activation_items.label: Current→Survivor preservation
activation_items.frozen_behavior: Current rejection, timeout, cancellation, close or no-fill cannot tombstone later Survivor discovery. Survivor independently reevaluates fresh evidence; same-asset observation may coexist with Current exposure but duplicate Survivor fill may not.
acceptance_proofs: Pump reject -> verified migration -> Survivor observation/independent evaluation survives
Pons reject -> verified graduation -> Survivor observation/independent evaluation survives
restart between Current decision and Survivor event cannot lose linkage
Current exposure blocks only duplicate same-asset Survivor fill, not observation
reject/outcome telemetry has zero trading authority and zero new decision-critical provider calls

activation_items.label: Right-tail trail
activation_items.frozen_behavior: At +100% high-water and above, Pump Current, Pons Current, Pump Survivor and Pons Survivor use the common tail rule: exit when current accrued gain falls to 60% of peak accrued gain.
acceptance_proofs: Pump Current uses common tail rule at +100% and above
Pons Current pre-graduation and post-graduation runner paths both use common tail rule
shared Survivor risk path applies common tail rule to both Pump Survivor and Pons Survivor
creator/distribution, liquidity, integrity, freshness and confirmed deterioration exits retain precedence

activation_items.label: Current tail bridge
activation_items.frozen_behavior: At an ordinary Current timeout, a proven winner may continue on the same Current lifecycle rather than being forced flat, only when every frozen bridge gate passes.
acceptance_proofs: high-water +4999 at timeout cannot enter bridge; +5000 can only if every other bridge gate passes
bridge preserves lifecycle ID, opened_at, original reference, high-water, realization and deterioration state
bridge deadline is original opened_at +129600 and survives restart
same-asset Survivor observation remains allowed and same-asset Survivor fill remains blocked until terminal reconciliation
any missing/stale safety evidence falls back to the existing Current timeout exit

activation_items.label: Staged winner scaling
activation_items.frozen_behavior: One and only one bounded add may occur after +100% high-water, first realization, 15-minute persistence, <=15% drawdown from high and full fresh strategy/safety/execution requalification.
acceptance_proofs: no add before 900 seconds after first +100% crossing
no add when current drawdown exceeds 15% from high
add is min(2.5% realized sleeve equity, 50% original basis, available capital, execution/capacity caps)
duplicate scale delivery cannot produce a second add
scale cannot reset original-entry high-water, hard stop, bridge clock, deterioration or exit intent
failed incremental reservation/commit leaves original position economically unchanged

activation_items.label: Meteora exit optimization
activation_items.frozen_behavior: Keep entry two-way balance >=20% and drift <=80%; immediate one-way adverse-flow exit becomes two-way balance <18% and drift >82%; post-core-hold economic collapse requires 3 verified 300-second segments.
acceptance_proofs: entry/exit hysteresis no longer overlaps at the old 25%/75% thresholds
2 collapse segments do not exit after core hold; 3 do
4-hour core hold, range-boundary/inventory risk exits and 24-hour maximum hold remain intact

composition_order: freeze authoritative green Stage-E SHA/tree/evidence receipt
create a new post-E integration branch/candidate from that exact SHA
apply/regenerate directional-realized-equity-sizing-v1 as the final sizing authority
apply right-tail-capture-v1 trail economics to Pump Current, both Pons Current runner paths and shared Survivor risk
implement same-lifecycle Current tail_bridge state and incremental scale reservation/commit/replay semantics
regenerate every affected policy hash, source manifest, implementation hash and frozen identity from final composed bytes
run deterministic activation matrix and full affected native/non-market suites
run exact-SHA non-market certification of the new composed PAPER candidate
only after that pass, authorize at most the separately permitted PAPER market smoke
restart fresh affected Pump/Pons/Meteora profitability cohorts
supersession_rules: Do not blindly apply preparation patches by commit order when the same source line is touched by multiple layers; regenerate a semantic final-SHA delta using this manifest as authority.
Directional capital parity freezes the 500-bps target; realized-equity compounding is the final sizing-basis authority.
Exit optimization freezes Pump/Pons ordinary exits and Meteora hysteresis; common right-tail trail supersedes only the Pump/Pons trail behavior at/above +100% high-water.
Right-tail scaling economics supersede any older staged-scaling null/research-only economic fields.
Current tail bridge extends only proven winning Current lifecycles and does not lower Survivor's existing six-hour admission minimum.
Ramses strategy is unchanged by this bundle.
